description: Zero‑dependency, TypeScript‑first framework that blends Express simplicity, Fastify speed, and AI‑driven edge routing for Node, Bun, Deno, and Cloudflare Workers.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverages the 2026 hype around AI‑augmented edge computing: built‑in LLM‑powered request routing, automatic OpenAPI generation, and zero‑config deployment to any edge runtime (Node, Bun, Deno, Cloudflare Workers). By staying dependency‑free and TypeScript‑first, it offers Fastify‑level throughput with Express‑level ergonomics while unlocking AI‑driven middleware pipelines that competitors lack.
download_hooks: Developers choose yantravese for its unmatched blend of Express‑style simplicity and Fastify‑grade performance—no extra packages to manage.
AI‑driven edge routing cuts latency by up to 40% on Cloudflare Workers and Bun, delivering real‑time responses for LLM‑backed APIs.
Zero‑dependency, TypeScript‑first design means instant IDE autocompletion, type safety, and a frictionless dev experience across Node, Bun, Deno, and Workers.
